fields.title: Amazon ranked product record
fields.description: One row per ranked product, plus rows for products that dropped out of the list. Rank and ASIN are present for every product in the top 100; title, price, rating and reviews come from the server-rendered tiles and cover roughly 60% of a 100-rank run - `hasDetails` says which. Movement fields compare against the previous run's snapshot. Every type is nullable accordingly.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The marketplace/listType/category this row came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-recs-list (rank + ASIN only), S1-recs-list+faceout (with full details), S2-snapshot-diff (a dropped-out product), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this row was captured.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, CAPTCHA_ESCALATION, EMPTY_RESULT). CAPTCHA_ESCALATION means Amazon served a CAPTCHA; this actor does not solve them.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

asin.title: ASIN
asin.description: Amazon product identifier - the key to join against your own data.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position in the list this run, 1 being best. Null on a dropped-out row.

title.title: Product title
title.description: Product name. Only on rows where hasDetails is true.

price.title: Price
price.description: Listed price as a number. Only on rows where hasDetails is true.

currencySymbol.title: Currency symbol
currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol as shown on the page, e.g. $ or £.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Star rating out of 5. Only on rows where hasDetails is true.

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Number of ratings behind the star score - a proxy for how established a product is.

productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: Canonical Amazon product URL, always present (built from the ASIN when the tile did not render).

hasDetails.title: Has details
hasDetails.description: False when only rank and ASIN could be captured, because Amazon lazy-loads roughly 20 of the 50 tiles on each page. Filter on this if your pipeline needs price and rating.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category slug or node path tracked.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain suffix, e.g. com or co.uk.

previousRank.title: Previous rank
previousRank.description: This product's rank in the previous run. Null for a brand-new entry.

rankChange.title: Rank change
rankChange.description: previousRank minus rank, so POSITIVE means it climbed (a lower rank number is better). Null for new entries and drop-outs.

movementType.title: Movement
movementType.description: NEW_ENTRY, RISING, FALLING, UNCHANGED, or DROPPED_OUT. The winning-product shortlist is NEW_ENTRY plus RISING.

isNewEntry.title: New entry
isNewEntry.description: True when the product was not in this list on the previous run.

isSignificantMove.title: Significant move
isSignificantMove.description: True for a move of 5+ ranks, a new entry or a drop-out - filtering out the noise of an hourly-reshuffling list.

amazonPercentageChange.title: Amazon % change
amazonPercentageChange.description: Amazon's own sales-rank percentage change from its Movers & Shakers metadata. Read when present, but it was empty on every page seen during recon - use rankChange instead.

amazonCurrentSalesRank.title: Amazon current sales rank
amazonCurrentSalesRank.description: Amazon's own current sales rank from Movers & Shakers metadata. Typically empty - see above.

amazonPreviousSalesRank.title: Amazon 24h-old sales rank
amazonPreviousSalesRank.description: Amazon's own 24-hour-old sales rank from Movers & Shakers metadata. Typically empty - see above.
